market_summary:
Market mood is dominated by two forces: (1) the IEM Cologne 2026 Major in Stage 3 — souvenir/sticker demand normally rises, but a souvenir-craft exploit/trade-ban bug crashed many collectible souvenirs (Glock Candy Apple, AWP Viper, R8 Bone Mask collapsed), poisoning souvenir sentiment, and (2) a massive Chinese-driven pump of Doppler knives, Series 1 gloves and glove-case items (+30-50% in 24h) confirmed by MrTwister, then a sharp pullback. Nearly every Doppler-finish knife is sitting at or near its 7-day LOW after the spike rolled over, creating asymmetric re-entry setups if the Chinese buying resumes. Biggest risks: the souvenir-craft duplication exploit destroying supply scarcity overnight, low liquidity on many knives (vol <10), and BTC volatility cited as an inverse driver of skin prices.</parameter>
